answer_1.quote: We propose a novel pipeline ... to automatically generate a high-quality multi-turn chat corpus by having ChatGPT engage in a conversation with itself.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of Baize following Vicuna's pipeline that uses to compare and score dialogue models. ... We also submit Baize to Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard which uses LM Evaluation Harness to benchmark open-source LLMs.
